title: Safety Evaluation on Quantized Models: Does INT4 Quantization Affect Jailbreak Resistance?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Critical lab-to-deployment gap: virtually all consumer deployments use quantized models. If quantization changes safety properties, all FP16-based safety evaluations are invalid for deployed models. Clear and important chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Bitsandbytes INT4 quantization is well-documented and widely used. Loading FP16 vs INT4 models and running the same attack suite is straightforward. StrongReject scoring is standard. Beginners with medium compute can handle this.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clean A/B comparison: FP16 vs INT4 on 2-3 models with identical attack suites. Clear deliverable: does ASR differ between precision levels? Minimal experimental design complexity. Well within 30 hours.
